title: Token Commitment as a Control Surface for Steering Masked Diffusion Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21669v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Masked diffusion models repeatedly predict provisional tokens before a sampler decides which predictions become permanent. Existing inference-time steering methods primarily modify activations, logits, or denoising trajectories, while treating this commitment policy as a fixed decoding detail. We instead study token commitment as a diffusion-specific control surface and separate it into two decisions: which tokens to commit and how many tokens to commit at each step. For the first, we introduce counterfactual target-aware commitment, which ranks unresolved positions by a mixture of model confidence and leave-one-token-out target contribution. For the second, we introduce calibrated adaptive budgets driven by target progress and confidence. translated_title: 令牌提交作为引导掩码扩散生成的控制界面
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散模型在采样器决定哪些预测成为永久之前，会反复预测临时令牌。现有的推理时引导方法主要修改激活值、logits或去噪轨迹，而将这种提交策略视为固定的解码细节。我们转而将令牌提交作为一种扩散模型特有的控制界面进行研究，并将其分解为两个决策：每一步提交哪些令牌以及提交多少令牌。针对第一个决策，我们引入了反事实目标感知提交机制，通过模型置信度与留一令牌目标贡献的混合来对未解决的位置进行排序。针对第二个决策，我们引入了由目标进度和置信度驱动的校准自适应预算。在LLaDA家族的语言和视觉-语言设置中，跨多个目标、两种激活引导方法以及无引导对照条件，两种机制均在经验上产生单调的目标质量提升。
tldr: 该论文提出将令牌提交策略（即每步提交哪些令牌和提交多少令牌）作为掩码扩散模型推理引导的新型控制界面，通过反事实目标感知提交和校准自适应预算两种机制，在语言和视觉-语言任务上实现了对生成过程的有效引导。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes token commitment—which tokens and how many tokens to commit at each step—as a novel diffusion-specific control surface for steering masked diffusion generation, introducing counterfactual target-aware commitment and calibrated adaptive budgets that yield empirically monotonic target quality improvements across language and vision-language settings.
